summary.prose: Building s1 means first making the providers safe for a pipeline that owns retries: one attempt on request, cancellation that reaches the call in flight, size refusals recognised in reviewer sessions, and an Ollama reviewer session that can only read. Then the review-pipeline module is built from the delivered review job, in two parts (job and driver steps, then the bounded gather) with its serial daemon driver. Finally every review kind is moved onto it through single-chunk adapters that keep today's prompts and results, ending with live probes and a daemon update.

When absent, behaviour is unchanged.

tasks.title: Pipeline core: job, prepare, envelope and driver steps
tasks.summary: Create src/workflow/review-pipeline. Move packIntoBatches (re-exported at its old path) and grow the delivered ReviewJob into ReviewPipelineJob, deleting review-job.ts and moving and rewriting its tests. Add the contracts sc1-sc4 and sc6 and the immutable snapshot (claims and evidence written once). Prepare: measure rendered calls, the single path, grouping by relation kind precedence (calls, same-file, same-module, references), the neighbourSummary slot, division with zero atoms, and AtomTooLargeError on a neighbour-free lower bound. Also: the envelope and fresh callIds; nextCalls; applyAnswer (schema, then validate(answer, call)); applyFailure (refusal re-division within maxChars, else half; one re-issue for transient, stall, mismatch and invalid answer); runStage; the per-stage failure policies; the deadlineAt rule (per-session limit times planned sessions, 30-minute cap per session); and the optional pipelineCalls on DimensionResult and ReviewReport.
acceptanceChecks: Under the limit, the plan is single and the calls carry today's messages and schema inside the envelope.
A missing or wrong callId, a transient error, a stall or an invalid answer is re-issued once under a new callId, and no prompt hash repeats.
A size refusal re-divides exactly the carried atoms and notes; the refused prompt is never resent.
Re-planning reads only the snapshot.

tasks.title: Serial daemon driver runReviewJob
tasks.summary: runReviewJob drives a job to the end serially: issue pending calls one at a time with internalRetry false and each call's execution mode (cwd, timeoutMs, or reviewer session with deadlineMs = min(deadlineAt - now, per-session limit)), run deterministic stages with runStage, apply answers and failures, pass the signal into every call, and return the adapter's result. A cancelled review ends at once with AbortError and records nothing.
acceptanceChecks: Calls are serial and each runs with its execution mode.
A cancel during a call in flight ends the review at once with AbortError, no re-issue, nothing recorded.
A re-issued session never restarts the deadline.

tasks.title: Code-review single-chunk adapters and runCodeReview
tasks.summary: One adapter per code-review dimension, each wrapping today's prompt builder unchanged, with daemon and controller stage plans. ux is a deterministic stage reading the snapshot's companion-mock fileFacts. Diagram keeps its handlers (deterministic ones as deterministic stages, a failing handler a LOW observation). Adherence makes no call without an approved LLD or plan. runCodeReview builds one job per expected dimension in today's order and drives it with runReviewJob, so the withStructuredRetry wrappers leave the review path. A dimension failing both attempts returns { ok: false, error } as today.
acceptanceChecks: An under-limit code review makes today's calls per dimension, with the repo as cwd, and gives today's findings and verdict, diagram and ux included.
Coverage is still normalised once over the dimension's result.
A mock added or removed after prepare does not change the ux result.

tasks.title: Design-review single-chunk adapters and runReview / runTemplateReview
tasks.summary: Premise adapter: extract (fail-review), probe (deterministic, runStage), and verify per premise (record-not-judged, the 3-minute timeoutMs, repo cwd as an addition). The controller plan uses today's single batched verify. Template adapter: one reviewer-session stage whose validate is today's checklist check, re-issued once by the pipeline with today's correction text, under job.deadlineAt. runReview and runTemplateReview switch to the pipeline; verifyOrRecord's own retry and the template re-ask leave the path.
acceptanceChecks: An under-limit DEF review makes one extract call, a probe and one verify call per premise with the 3-minute limit; extraction failing fails the review; a verify call failing twice records the premise as not judged.
An under-limit HLD review makes one reviewer-session call and gives today's report; a checklist break is re-issued once by the pipeline.
The controller premise plan under the limit offers one batched verify call.
